title: Tivoli Hotel, Panama (1923)
visualBrief: Dated1923whole main TivoliHotel: broad white timber/plaster frame with repeated dark screened verandah/window bays above a raised masonry base, two projecting front crosswings/open forecourt, central higher front/cupola, connected1911rear wing and visible low attached side block. Separate overhanging hipped roofs, small white roof vents, eight-post cupola/hipped cap and intrinsic1913-era entrance porch/porte-cochere/steps. Full plan/metric scale/bearing are photographic estimates at the former-site story coordinate. Historical-only1923-06-16appearance; no default current-world hotel.
